citations.text: Witvliet, Daniel, et al. (2020). Connectomes across development reveal principles of brain maturation. Nature.

description: Directed multigraph of chemical synapses in the L3 larval stage C. elegans. Each synapse is a separate unweighted edge. Multiple synapses create multi-edges. Gap junctions excluded. No autapses.
name: C. elegans L3 Larval Chemical Connectome (Witvliet 2020)
